-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem memLog_app [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (a b :
    List EntryM) : memLog γs k dq (a ++ b) ⊣⊢ memLog γs k dq a ∗ memLog γs (k + a.length) dq b

theorem MemJust.B_persistent.{u_1} (J : MemJust GF) (k : Nat) : Persistent (J.B k)

theorem memCompacted_mono [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (c c' : Nat) (h : c' ≤ c)
    : memCompacted γs c ⊢ memCompacted γs c'

def memStorN : Namespace :=
  nroot.@"raft_memstor"

theorem memStorFresh_compacted [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (c : Nat)
    : memStorFresh ms γs ∗ memCompacted γs c ⊢ ⌜c = 0⌝ ∗ memStorFresh ms γs

theorem MemJust.B_timeless'.{u_1} (J : MemJust GF) (k : Nat) : Timeless (J.B k)

def memKey (γ : GName) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γ 1 ()

structure MemStorNames : Type where
  log : GName
  en : GName
  ek : GName
  cp : GName
  jc : GName
  sx : GName
  lk : GName
  hk : GName

theorem memStorLock_persistent (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : Persistent (memStorLock ms γs)

theorem memLogL_lookup (γ : GName) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) (j : Nat) (e : EntryM)
    (h : es[j]? = some e) : memLogL γ k dq es ⊢ k + j ↪[γ]{dq} e ∗ (k + j ↪[γ]{dq} e -∗ memLogL γ k
    dq es)

def memStorLock (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
      sync.isMutex (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"Mutex" ms) (memstorageInv ms γs))

theorem memLogL_insert (γ : GName) (M : GMap Nat EntryM) (k : Nat) (es : List EntryM) (Habs : ∀ (i :
    Nat), k ≤ i → i < k + es.length → M !! i = none) : ⊢ ghostMapAuth γ 1 M ==∗ ∃ M', ghostMapAuth γ
    1 M' ∗ memLogL γ k (DFrac.own 1) es ∗ ⌜∀ (i : Nat), M' !! i = if k ≤ i ∧ i < k + es.length then
    es[i - k]? else M !! i⌝

theorem memLogL_frozen_ne (γ : GName) (k : Nat) (es : List EntryM) (i : Nat) (e : EntryM) : ⊢
    memLogL γ k (DFrac.own 1) es -∗ i ↪[γ]□ e -∗ ⌜i < k ∨ k + es.length ≤ i⌝

def memLogL (γ : GName) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) : List EntryM → IProp GF :=
  List.brecOn (motive := fun x => Nat → IProp GF) x✝ (memLogL._f γ dq) k

def memstorageInv (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ p ents M sv,
      "Hfields" ∷ memstorageFields ms (memPhys p ents) ∗
        "Hlog" ∷ ghostMapAuth γs.log 1 M ∗
          "Hen" ∷ ghostVar γs.en (Qp.half 1) (uint.nat p.index' + 1 + ents.length) ∗
            "Hcp" ∷ monoNatAuthOwn γs.cp 1 (uint.nat p.index') ∗
              "#Hcj" ∷ memCompJust γs (uint.nat p.index') ∗
                "Hsx" ∷ ghostVar γs.sx memQ sv ∗
                  "Hlk" ∷ memKey γs.lk ∗
                    ("#Hd0" ∷ ∃ e0, uint.nat p.index' ↪[γs.log]□ e0 ∗ ⌜e0.Term' = p.term'⌝) ∗
                      "#Hsf" ∷
                          (⌜uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' = 0⌝ ∨
                            ∃ e, uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' ↪[γs.log]□ e ∗ ⌜e.Term' = sv.Metadata'.Term'⌝) ∗
                        "%Hok" ∷ ⌜MemOk p ents M sv⌝)

def memJustInv (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ L, monoListAuthOwn γs.jc 1 L ∗ [∗list] k ∈ L, J.B k) ∗ (memSnapHome ms γs J ∨ memKey γs.lk))

theorem memLogL_frac (γ : GName) (k : Nat) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) : memLogL γ k (dq1 •
    dq2) es ⊣⊢ memLogL γ k dq1 es ∗ memLogL γ k dq2 es

def memCompJust (γs : MemStorNames) (c : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ L, monoListLbOwn γs.jc L ∗ ⌜c ∈ L⌝)

def MemOk (p : entryID) (ents : List EntryM) (M : GMap Nat EntryM) (sv : SnapshotM) : Prop :=
  uint.nat p.index' + 1 + ents.length ≤ 2 ^ 61 ∧
    (∀ (i : Nat), uint.nat p.index' + 1 + ents.length ≤ i → M !! i = none) ∧
      (∀ (i : Nat),
          uint.nat p.index' < i → i < uint.nat p.index' + 1 + ents.length → M !! i = ents[i - uint.nat p.index' - 1]?) ∧
        uint.nat p.index' ≤ uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' ∧
          uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index' < uint.nat p.index' + 1 + ents.length ∧
            ∀ (j : Nat) (e : EntryM), ents[j]? = some e → uint.nat e.Index' = uint.nat p.index' + 1 + j

theorem memCompacted_persistent (γs : MemStorNames) (c : Nat) : Persistent (memCompacted γs c)

theorem MemJust.SV_persistent.{u_1} (J : MemJust GF) (sv : SnapshotM) : Persistent (J.SV sv)

theorem memKey_timeless (γ : GName) : Timeless (memKey γ)

theorem memCompacted_zero [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) : ⊢ memCompacted γs 0

def memStorMeta (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (hs : HardStateM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ n hp,
      "#Hinit" ∷ isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
        "#Hmu" ∷ sync.isMutex (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"Mutex" ms) (memstorageInv ms γs) ∗
          "HhardState" ∷
              typedPointsto (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"hardState" ms)
                hp (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ∗
            "#Hhs" ∷ hsOpt hp hs ∗
              "Hcs_initialState" ∷
                typedPointsto
                  (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats
                    go!"initialState"
                    (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats" ms))
                  n (DFrac.own 1))

theorem memLogL_timeless (γ : GName) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) : Timeless (memLogL γ
    k dq es)

theorem memLog_bound [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (es :
    List EntryM) : memLog γs k dq es ⊢ ⌜es = [] ∨ k + es.length ≤ 2 ^ 61⌝

theorem memStorInvP_persistent (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust GF) : Persistent
    (memStorInvP ms γs J)

theorem memLogL_auth (γ : GName) (q : Qp) (M : GMap Nat EntryM) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (es : List
    EntryM) : ⊢ ghostMapAuth γ q M -∗ memLogL γ k dq es -∗ ⌜∀ (j : Nat) (e : EntryM), es[j]? = some
    e → M !! (k + j) = some e⌝

theorem memBnd_pers.{u_1} (J : MemJust GF) (c : Nat) : Persistent (memBnd J c)

theorem memLog_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) : ⊢ memLog
    γs k dq []

def memQ : Qp :=
  (Qp.half 1).half

theorem memSnap_update [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (a b c sv' : SnapshotM) : ⊢
    ghostVar γs.sx (Qp.half 1) a -∗ ghostVar γs.sx memQ b -∗ ghostVar γs.sx memQ c ==∗ ghostVar
    γs.sx (Qp.half 1) sv' ∗ ghostVar γs.sx memQ sv' ∗ ghostVar γs.sx memQ sv'

theorem memSnap_put [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust GF) (E :
    CoPset) (hE : ↑memStorN ⊆ E) : ⊢ memStorInvP ms γs J -∗ memSnapHome ms γs J ={E}=∗ memKey γs.lk

theorem memLog_persistent (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (es : List EntryM) : Persistent (memLog γs k
    DFrac.discard es)

def memSnapExact (γs : MemStorNames) (sv : SnapshotM) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γs.sx (Qp.half 1) sv

theorem memLogL_delete (γ : GName) (M : GMap Nat EntryM) (k : Nat) (es : List EntryM) : ⊢
    ghostMapAuth γ 1 M -∗ memLogL γ k (DFrac.own 1) es ==∗ ∃ M', ghostMapAuth γ 1 M' ∗ ⌜∀ (i : Nat),
    M' !! i = if k ≤ i ∧ i < k + es.length then none else M !! i⌝

theorem memLogL_app (γ : GName) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (a b : List EntryM) : memLogL γ k dq (a ++ b)
    ⊣⊢ memLogL γ k dq a ∗ memLogL γ (k + a.length) dq b

def memstorageFields (ms : Loc) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ hp es dummy nfi nli nen nte nsn,
      "HhardState" ∷
          typedPointsto (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"hardState" ms) hp
            (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ∗
        "Hents_f" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"ents" ms) es (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          "Hents" ∷ entsRO es (dummy :: σ.ents) ∗
            "Hents_cap" ∷ ownSliceCap Loc es (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              "%Hdummy" ∷ ⌜dummy.Index' = σ.prev.index' ∧ dummy.Term' = σ.prev.term'⌝ ∗
                "Hcs_firstIndex" ∷
                    typedPointsto
                      (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats
                        go!"firstIndex"
                        (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats" ms))
                      nfi (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                  "Hcs_lastIndex" ∷
                      typedPointsto
                        (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats
                          go!"lastIndex"
                          (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats" ms))
                        nli (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                    "Hcs_entries" ∷
                        typedPointsto
                          (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats go!"entries"
                            (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats" ms))
                          nen (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                      "Hcs_term" ∷
                          typedPointsto
                            (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats go!"term"
                              (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats"
                                ms))
                            nte (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                        "Hcs_snapshot" ∷
                          typedPointsto
                            (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats go!"snapshot"
                              (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats"
                                ms))
                            nsn (DFrac.own 1))

def memBnd.{u_1} (J : MemJust GF) (c : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ k, ⌜c ≤ k⌝ ∗ J.B k)

theorem MemJust.DL_persistent.{u_1} (J : MemJust GF) (i : Nat) : Persistent (J.DL i)

theorem memCompJust_persistent (γs : MemStorNames) (c : Nat) : Persistent (memCompJust γs c)

def memCompacted (γs : MemStorNames) (c : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜c = 0⌝ ∨ monoNatLbOwn γs.cp c ∗ ∃ L, monoListLbOwn γs.jc L ∗ ⌜∃ k, k ∈ L ∧ c ≤ k⌝)

def memCsArg (cs : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (oc : Option ConfStateM) : IProp GF :=
  match oc with
  | none => iprop(⌜cs = null⌝)
  | some c => ownCSM cs dq c

theorem memStorInvP_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust
    GF) (E : CoPset) : ⊢ memStorLock ms γs -∗ memStorFresh ms γs -∗ J.B 0 ={E}=∗ memStorInvP ms γs J

theorem memLogL.eq_def (γ : GName) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (x✝ : List EntryM) : memLogL γ k dq x✝ =
    match x✝ with | [] => iprop(emp) | e :: es => iprop(k ↪[γ]{dq} e ∗ memLogL γ (k + 1) dq es)

def memSnapEmpty : SnapshotM :=
  { Data' := [],
    Metadata' :=
      { ConfState' := { Voters' := [], Learners' := [], VotersOutgoing' := [], LearnersNext' := [], AutoLeave' := false },
        Index' := W64 0, Term' := W64 0 } }

def memEnd (γs : MemStorNames) (e : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostVar γs.en (Qp.half 1) e ∗ memKey γs.ek)

structure MemJust.{u_1} (GF : BundledGFunctors) : Type u_1 where
  SV : IProp GF
  B : IProp GF
  DL : IProp GF
  SV_pers : Persistent (self.SV sv)
  B_pers : Persistent (self.B k)
  B_timeless : Timeless (self.B k)
  DL_pers : Persistent (self.DL i)

theorem memLog_frac [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (es
    : List EntryM) : memLog γs k (dq1 • dq2) es ⊣⊢ memLog γs k dq1 es ∗ memLog γs k dq2 es

theorem memKey_excl (γ : GName) : ⊢ memKey γ -∗ memKey γ -∗ False

def memPhys (p : entryID) (ents : List EntryM) : StorState :=
  { prev := p, ents := ents, pend := [] }

theorem memElem_frac (γ : GName) (k : Nat) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (e : EntryM) : k ↪[γ]{dq1 • dq2} e ⊣⊢ k
    ↪[γ]{dq1} e ∗ k ↪[γ]{dq2} e

theorem memSnap_take [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust GF) (E
    : CoPset) (hE : ↑memStorN ⊆ E) : ⊢ memStorInvP ms γs J -∗ memKey γs.lk ={E}=∗ ▷ memSnapHome ms
    γs J

def memStorFresh (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoListAuthOwn γs.jc 1 [0] ∗
      memKey γs.hk ∗
        ∃ sp,
          typedPointsto (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"snapshot" ms) sp
              (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            ownSnapM sp (DFrac.own 1) memSnapEmpty ∗ ghostVar γs.sx memQ memSnapEmpty)

theorem memEnd_excl [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (e e' : Nat) : memEnd γs e ∗
    memEnd γs e' ⊢ False

def memDummy (sv : SnapshotM) : EntryM :=
  { Term' := sv.Metadata'.Term', Index' := sv.Metadata'.Index', Type' := zeroValDef, Data' := [] }

theorem memLog_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (es :
    List EntryM) : ⊢ memLog γs k dq es ==∗ memLog γs k DFrac.discard es

def memSnapHome (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(memKey γs.hk ∗
      ∃ sp sv,
        typedPointsto (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"snapshot" ms) sp
            (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          ownSnapM sp (DFrac.own 1) sv ∗
            ghostVar γs.sx memQ sv ∗ (⌜sv.Metadata'.Index' = W64 0⌝ ∨ J.SV sv ∗ J.DL (uint.nat sv.Metadata'.Index')))

theorem memLogL_persist (γ : GName) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) : ⊢ memLogL γ k dq es
    ==∗ memLogL γ k DFrac.discard es

theorem memSnapExact_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (a b : SnapshotM) : ⊢
    memSnapExact γs a -∗ ghostVar γs.sx memQ b -∗ ⌜a = b⌝

def memSnapCreated (sv0 : SnapshotM) (i t : w64) (oc : Option ConfStateM) (bs : List w8) : SnapshotM
    :=
  { Data' := bs, Metadata' := { ConfState' := oc.getD sv0.Metadata'.ConfState', Index' := i, Term' := t } }

def memStorInvP (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(memStorLock ms γs ∗ J.B 0 ∗ inv memStorN (memJustInv ms γs J))

theorem memCompacted_bound [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust
    GF) (c : Nat) : ⊢ memStorInvP ms γs J -∗ memCompacted γs c ={⊤}=∗ memBnd J c

def memLog (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(memLogL γs.log k dq es ∗ ⌜es = [] ∨ k + es.length ≤ 2 ^ 61⌝)

theorem memCompJust_register [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (J : MemJust
    GF) (k : Nat) (E : CoPset) (hE : ↑memStorN ⊆ E) : ⊢ memStorInvP ms γs J -∗ J.B k ={E}=∗
    memCompJust γs k

theorem memstorageFields_congr [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (σ σ' : StorState) (h1 :
    σ'.prev = σ.prev) (h2 : σ'.ents = σ.ents) : memstorageFields ms σ ⊢ memstorageFields ms σ'

theorem memLogL_persistent (γ : GName) (k : Nat) (es : List EntryM) : Persistent (memLogL γ k
    DFrac.discard es)
